lines.zh: 我一走，地板就往下一沉。
lines.en: The floor sinks a little with each of my steps.
My head nearly brushes the rafters.

lines.zh: 我在门口停下，挤不进去。
lines.en: I stop at the doorway; I don't fit.
One stride takes me the length of the hall.
I have to stoop to see the door.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住了整面墙。
lines.en: My shadow covers the whole wall.

lines.zh: 我把肩膀侧过来，才通过。
lines.en: I turn my shoulder to get through.

lines.zh: 我每动一下，屋子都在响。
lines.en: Every movement makes the house creak.

lines.zh: 我的手掌贴在天花板上。
lines.en: My palm presses the ceiling.
I follow you, slowly.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留下凹痕。
lines.en: My steps leave dents behind.

lines.zh: 我的脚步一声一声压过来。
lines.en: My footsteps press nearer, one by one.
I stand, my head against a beam.
My breath lifts the dust.
I keep my head low so I don't hit anything.
My hand hangs beside the floor.
When I move, the walls shudder.

lines.zh: 我在看你，你看不见全貌。
lines.en: I'm looking at you; you can't see all of me.
My knee is taller than the table.
I raise my hand, very slowly.
This whole house is too small for me.
I draw myself in a little.
Dust falls from the beams.
I take one slow breath.
Do you understand now?
Looking down at you tires me.

lines.zh: 我一伸手就能碰到房梁。
lines.en: One reach and I touch the rafters.
Are you going to call for help?
I could take the roof off.
Backing away further won't help.
I wait with great patience.

lines.zh: 你的声音在我这里很小。
lines.en: Your voice is very small to me.
I don't even have to bend.
I'm pleased with this size.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，头要抬高。
lines.en: You have to crane your neck to see me.
You may try running.
The floor can't hold the both of us.
I'm not the slightest bit hurried.
You're very small in here.
I'd like to hear you more clearly.
I swayed and the wall cracked.
That was very small to me.
I gave half a step and the floor dented.
My head knocked the beam.

lines.zh: 我撞在梁上，整栋楼都颤。
lines.en: I strike the beam and the whole house shakes.
That's a very little blood.
I settle my bulk again.
Would you like to try again?

lines.zh: 我听不见你手里的东西。
lines.en: I can't hear what's in your hand.
Your food is too small to see.
That's far too small for me.
You eat it yourself.

lines.zh: 我一根手指就能盖住它。
lines.en: One finger would cover it.

lines.zh: 我这么大，你抬头才看得全。
lines.en: I am this large; look up to see all of me.
This changes no outcome at all.
I lack nothing at all.
You hit my shin.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，整个屋子晃。
lines.en: I step back and the whole house shakes.
I shoulder you a good distance.
I keep my movements as small as I can.
You've stepped on my shoe.

lines.zh: 我的影子一压，你就暗了。
lines.en: My shadow falls and you go dark.

lines.zh: 我弯腰的时候灰落下来。
lines.en: Dust falls when I bend.
You back into the corner, which is tighter.
My fingers only grazed you.
That was not light for you.
There's only one of me at this size.
The others are all smaller than me.
I've seen the smaller ones.
We never appear at the same time.
They walk beneath me.

lines.zh: 我一低头就能看见它们。
lines.en: One glance down and I can see them.
They all seem a little afraid of me.

lines.zh: 我也记得自己小的样子。
lines.en: I remember being that small.
That phase has passed.
Now only I stand this tall.
Bending down takes me a long while.
Two fingers lift it easily.

lines.zh: 我两指捏着，放到窗台上。
lines.en: I pinch it between two fingers and set it on the sill.
I can't see what's on the floor.
It's smaller than my fingernail.

lines.zh: 这些对我来说都是碎片。
lines.en: All of this is fragments to me.

lines.zh: 那么小的东西，也值得你捡？
lines.en: Something that small is worth picking up?

lines.zh: 丢下它，巨型的手掌够得着。
lines.en: Drop it. This giant hand reaches far.
A single pace bridges this gap.
You're in such a small room.

lines.zh: 我不用弯腰也能碰到你。
lines.en: I can reach you without bending.
The roof is in the way. It doesn't matter.

lines.zh: 你把头抬起来，正好看见我。
lines.en: You lift your head and there I am.
I bend my knee slowly.
I'd very much like to take this place apart.
I've left half the doorway open.
This step is slow.
You'll hear me coming.
My hand is already above you.
Take a look above you.
One look down and you'd be gone.
I've measured your distance.
One stride carries me over the whole staircase.
Wherever you run, I can see you.

lines.zh: 这栋房子的每一层我都听得见。
lines.en: I hear every floor of this house.
Your panting echoes in the walls.
When I move, you know I'm there.
I need not chase at all.
I'll wait for you to tire.
My fingers scrape the beam.
You're downstairs; I'm up here.

lines.zh: 你把头抬起来看了一眼。
lines.en: You raised your head and looked once.
I'm standing right here.
Every route is blocked by me.
I'll come a little closer.
The floorboards keep creaking below.
My fingertips already touch the beam.
My hand comes down, slowly.
The whole house rings from that.
You're shoved toward the wall.
I held back as much as I could.
That was far too heavy for you.
I raise my knee.
You're in the middle of my palm.

lines.zh: 我的掌心落下，地板凹了一块。
lines.en: My palm comes down and the floor dents.
I slowly open my hand.
You're still on the floor.
I step back half a pace and the house settles.
I don't want to wreck this place.
But I don't mind if I do.

lines.zh: 我站起来，屋顶被顶了一下。
lines.en: I stand and the roof takes a knock.

lines.zh: 这个体型一次比一次大。
lines.en: Each form is bigger than the last.
First I look down for the way.

lines.zh: 地板响了一声，是我站起。
lines.en: The floor creaked; that was me standing.
I draw my body in as much as I can.
This house is too low for me.
My shadow fills the whole floor.
I hear someone on the lower level.
I try to plant my feet.

lines.zh: 我的高度让我自己都意外。
lines.en: My own height surprises me.
I raise a hand to look at it.
Dust falls from my shoulders.
I get used to this place, step by step.

lines.zh: 我停住了，整栋楼静下来。
lines.en: I stop, and the whole building goes quiet.
Now I begin looking.

lines.zh: 巨型形态，一抬头就遮住天。
lines.en: In giant form, my head blots the sky.
Even my breathing makes a draught.
The door looks tiny to me.
I am starting now.
The firelight is far smaller than I am.

lines.zh: 我落地时整层楼都在跳。
lines.en: When I land, the whole floor jumps.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的膝盖，仍然很浅。
lines.en: Water reaches my knees. It's still shallow.
The blast only makes me rock.
The arrow snaps against my hide.
Light wraps me, but it's far too small.
At this size, hunger comes fast.

lines.zh: 雷打在我肩上，我听得很清楚。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my shoulder. I hear it clearly.
Nothing here can hold my weight.
